citations.text: Bureau of Transportation Statistics, Federal Highway Administration. Freight Analysis Framework, version 5.7.1.

description: Freight Analysis Framework 5.7.1 origin-destination freight flows between FAF regions (domestic zones and foreign regions), estimated for 2017 to 2024 and forecast to 2050. Each row is a flow from an origin zone to a destination zone for one commodity (SCTG2), mode and trade type, with tonnage, value and ton-miles for each year; graph/v1 is the target, zones as nodes and flows as edges carrying those figures, which keepset's edge-list parser cannot yet carry (it reads topology only). The codebook FAF5_metadata.xlsx is in the zip.
name: Freight Analysis Framework 5.7.1 regional flows

recipe.reason: The flows are one CSV member of a zip that unpacks to more than a gigabyte: streaming reads a CSV table inside a tar member a chunk at a time but not one inside a zip, and a fetch holds the whole member as one text, which is past what a JavaScript string can hold. The edge-list parser also carries no edge attributes, so the tonnage, value and ton-mile columns would be lost. Tracked in https://github.com/Mearman/keepset/issues/306.
